g.title: CAN
g.text: 500 kbit/s; model recorded on the checklist
Ch A sends 0x343 every 10 ms, ch B sends 0x1AA every 10 ms; both log error counters.

g.title: X1
g.text: TE 1318774-1; bench mating plug to choose
Harness type assumed Toyota A with box v3 (DQ-211 C). X1, X2 and the box are joined by the Toyota A harness as drawn in e05-toyota-a-harness.

g.title: BO

VS-HW-22 step 4 and VS-HW-23 step 3 put the reference device on the OBD-C cable here instead.
